summary: CCC-era steel observation tower on Waubay NWR, Day County: 110 ft above ground, 133 steps, built 1935; refuge open during daylight hours. Listed as standing.

access.note: The refuge is open during daylight hours every day; the brochure invites visitors to climb the tower.

visit.trail_note: 133 steps to the top, 110 feet above ground.

notes_for_editor: Built 1935 (brochure and marker agree on the CCC work). Height of 110 ft above ground and 133 steps come from the brochure only; height_m 33.5 is the brochure's figure converted, and 'above ground' is taken as the structure height. 'Steel' rests on one listing (westlookouts). Current condition not verified. Search results said the Waubay tower is a steel tower built by the CCC; only the listed sources were used. The Sand Lake marker also says the Waubay tower is open to the public during daylight hours, but the story uses the refuge's own page.
